SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (
                        WHERE current_samples_insufficient
                          AND NOT baseline_samples_insufficient) AS "Current samples only",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (
                        WHERE baseline_samples_insufficient
                          AND NOT current_samples_insufficient) AS "Baseline samples only",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (
                        WHERE current_samples_insufficient
                          AND baseline_samples_insufficient) AS "Both sample requirements",

                        WHERE NOT current_samples_insufficient
                          AND NOT baseline_samples_insufficient
                          AND NOT rule_eligible) AS "Missing rates"
FROM public.mart_hourly_investigation
WHERE hour_ts >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2020-02-01 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US')
  AND hour_ts < TO_TIMESTAMP('2020-09-02 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US')

chart_checks.chart: Hourly low-pressure share, historical baseline and rule (%)
chart_checks.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', hour_ts) AS __timestamp,
       100.0 * SUM(low_pressure_loaded_readings) / NULLIF(SUM(loaded_readings), 0) AS "Low pressure among loaded (%)",
       CASE
           WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN 100.0 * MAX(prior_low_fraction)
       END AS "Prior 7-day loaded share (%)",
       15.0 AS "Rule floor (%)",
       CASE
           WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN 200.0 * MAX(prior_low_fraction)
       END AS "2x prior baseline (%)"
FROM public.mart_hourly_investigation
WHERE hour_ts >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2020-02-01 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US')
  AND hour_ts < TO_TIMESTAMP('2020-09-02 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US')
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', hour_ts)
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT incident_id AS incident_id,
       DATE_TRUNC('day', starts_at) AS starts_at,
       ends_at AS ends_at,
       candidate_hours AS candidate_hours,
       readings AS readings,
       loaded_readings AS loaded_readings,
       low_pressure_share AS low_pressure_share,
       peak_hour_share AS peak_hour_share,
       overlaps_reported_failure AS overlaps_reported_failure,
       rule_version AS rule_version
FROM public.mart_incidents
WHERE starts_at >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2020-02-01 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US')
  AND starts_at < TO_TIMESTAMP('2020-09-02 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US')
GROUP BY incident_id,
         DATE_TRUNC('day', starts_at),
         ends_at,
         candidate_hours,
         readings,
         loaded_readings,
         low_pressure_share,
         peak_hour_share,
         overlaps_reported_failure,
         rule_version
ORDER BY starts_at ASC
LIMIT 10000;
